newsitem.title: FRANCE: French LCI TV news channel on two digital services.
newsitem.headline: French LCI TV news channel on two digital services.

text.p: La Chaine Info (LCI), France's answer to the CNN's 24-hour news television channel, will be available on both the TPS and Canalsatellite digital satellite television services, a Canalsatellite official said on Tuesday.
Canalsatellite, which started services in April, has so far had the exclusive satellite rights to LCI.
TPS, a joint venture with TF1, state-owned France Television and Lyonnaise des Eaux as main partners, will start services this month.

"TF1 had the choice between leaving the exclusivity of LCI to Canalsatellite and get a guaranteed minimum payment of 40 million francs, or forego the payment and broadcast LCI as well," said a spokeswoman for Canal Plus which runs Canalsatellite.
LCI was set up by TF1, France's main commercial broadcaster majority owned by Bouygues and was available on cable networks only.
Patrick Le Lay, chairman of TF1, is set to announce the decision to staff at LCI later on Tuesday, industry sources said.
